result.title: Flownomaly: Single-Step Conditional-Mean Recovery for Few-Shot Anomaly Detection
result.summary: Few-shot industrial anomaly detection requires modeling category-specific normality from only a handful of defect-free images. Common approaches tie inference to stored exemplars, impose rigid linear structure, or risk reproducing anomalous content. Flownomaly instead casts the problem as normal-counterpart recovery in frozen DINOv2 feature space. Given normal supports, a velocity field is learned through conditional flow matching over frozen patch tokens to transport Gaussian noise toward normal features. Along straight paths, a single recovery step using one evaluation of the optimal field yields the posterior mean of the clean normal token without trajectory integration. The operating time governs how strongly recovery modifies a query token. With no anomalous validation samples available for tuning, a normal-only Jacobian gain-to-noise criterion selects this time from the supports alone. Squared residuals between query tokens and their recovered counterparts yield anomaly signals for both dense localization and image-level detection. Across 1-, 2-, and 4-shot benchmarks on MVTec-AD and VisA, together with sample-shot evaluations on Real-IAD, Flownomaly achieves state-of-the-art performance against recent category-specific methods. In the 1-shot setting, image- and pixel-level AUROC reach 97.8% and 98.0% on MVTec-AD and 95.3% and 98.7% on VisA, with a 2.1-point image-level AUROC improvement over the strongest baseline on VisA. Code is available at https://github.com/b-rbmp/Flownomaly.

AI.brief_summary: 论文把少样本工业异常检测改写为「正常对应物恢复」：在冻结的 DINOv2 patch 特征上用 conditional flow matching 学速度场，沿直线路径单步取后验均值替代轨迹积分，并以仅用正常支持样本的 Jacobian 增益-噪声准则选择该步时间，用残差做定位与图像级检测。
AI.relevance_reason: 单步条件流匹配直接产出后验均值状态、以及无需异常样本即决定「更新多强」的准则，可能为 LVR 中视觉 token 状态的更新幅度与停止/计算分配提供可核查线索，但任务差距较大，迁移价值需阅读原文判断。
